title: Blue Lock
subtitle: Egoist striker project
description: A radical take on sports anime that abandons the traditional power of friendship for raw, unadulterated ego. It dissects the psychology of what makes a world-class striker, emphasizing that to stand at the pinnacle, one must be willing to consume others' dreams.
quotes: I will be the best striker in the world.
Football is not a game of friendship, it's a game of ego.
